$comment: قرارٌ لا قياس: أيُّ أسباب «مجهول» تُقبل لعمليّةٍ معلَنة لم تُثبَت ولم تُنفَ. الأعدادُ ليست هنا — تُشتقّ في المصنوعة (edge_resolution.classification). يفرضه exemption_problems في scripts/diagnostics/resolve_inventory_edges.py عبر tests_v9/test_inventory_edge_classification.py: سببٌ مستعمَلٌ غيرُ معلَن، أو معلَنٌ بلا مبرّرٍ أو شرطِ إغلاق، أو معلَنٌ لم يعد مستعمَلاً (بائت) ⇒ أحمر.

call_site_binding_unproven.justification: A literal call site matches the operation exactly, but the client identifier's import cannot be proven to bind the canonical axios instance (a re-export the reader cannot follow, or the identifier is also used in a non-receiver position in that file). Promoting it would accept a shadowed or re-bound identifier as proof.
call_site_binding_unproven.closing_condition: The binding reader proves the import chain for that file (named relative import/re-export, no ambiguous use), at which point the row becomes proven; or the call site is removed and the operation falls to another class.

dynamic_call_may_reach.justification: An application call builds its path at runtime (identifier argument, concatenation, or an unsupported template expression). Its literal prefix, routed through the gateway, is compatible with this operation's browser path, so the call may reach it; static scanning cannot say whether it does.
dynamic_call_may_reach.closing_condition: The call is rewritten with a literal or simple template path the scanner reads (then proven or not), or a runtime trace binds the call to concrete paths.

client_passed_as_value.justification: A client instance is passed, stored or used other than as a direct `client.method(path)` receiver (e.g. a service-health table of `{api, path}` objects). Whatever path is requested through it is invisible to a call-site scanner, so every gateway-compatible operation of its prefix stays possible.
client_passed_as_value.closing_condition: The value use is replaced by direct literal calls, or the scanner gains a data-flow class that follows the value to its call.

not_seen_by_axios_scanner.justification: The gateway routes a browser path to this operation, yet no axios call reaches it. The scanner reads axios client calls only; fetch, WebSocket, EventSource and asset URLs (map tiles) are outside it, so absence of a call is absence of sight, not of the relation. Its site is the gateway rule that makes the operation reachable.
not_seen_by_axios_scanner.closing_condition: An evidence class for the remaining transport (e.g. WebSocket constructors) is built and proves or leaves it, or the operation is withdrawn from the frontend consumer declaration.
